# CashBooks Phase Gates

This file is generated from machine-readable criteria under `agent-system/work/`. The source
for G0 is `agent-system/work/P0/gates/G0-criteria.json`; results are written separately and
never copied into the criteria source.

## G0 — P0 control-plane gate

| Criterion | Requirement | Evidence type | Evidence source |
|---|---|---|---|
| G0-01 | The root is one Git repository | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-02 | The original AppleBooks history remains reachable and its imported tree is unchanged | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-03 | No nested Git repository remains active | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-04 | Every valid example validates and every static must-fail fixture is rejected | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-05 | A dependency DAG can expose several tasks as ready simultaneously | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-06 | Lease fencing and path-lock conflicts are rejected for their specific reasons | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-07 | Semantic-lock conflicts are rejected independently of path locks | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-08 | A self-review claim is rejected by recorded identity comparison | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-09 | Context hashes invalidate stale consumers and permit an explicit rebuild | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-10 | The human-readable and machine-readable document authority orders agree byte-for-byte | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-11 | Documentation checks pass from a clean checkout | deterministic check | re-executed command |
| G0-12 | An independent architectural authority completed the G0 architecture audit with no blocking findings | artifact | `agent-system/work/P0/gates/G0-architecture-audit.json` |
| G0-13 | The human approves the active product scope and its explicitly deferred programs | human approval | `agent-system/work/P0/approvals/G0-scope-approval.json` |
| G0-14 | The human approves the authority map and authorizes evaluation against this immutable G0 criteria set | human approval | `agent-system/work/P0/approvals/G0-phase-approval.json` |

G0-13 and G0-14 are separate bindings derived from design criterion 13. The scope approval
binds the scope-statement document set; the phase approval binds the immutable criteria file.

## Later gates

G1, G2, G3-B, and G3-L criteria are intentionally not transcribed during P0. Each set is
materialized at its preceding gate against real repository state and accepted interfaces.
